findings.summary: The artwork log line now emits the result's bounded classification exactly when one is present, in a shape that distinguishes the three kinds, and omits it otherwise.
findings.detail: DescribeClassification(result) (src/ArrTags/Artwork/ArtworkGenerationCoordinator.cs lines 160-178) returns ' (PassThroughReason=<enum>)', ' (FailureReason=<enum>)', or ' (SourceFailureReason=<enum>)' from the nullable properties of ArtworkGenerationResult, and is interpolated once in the single LogOutcome message between {result.Outcome} and {result.Reason} (line 145). It is the only _log.Write in the coordinator. ArtworkGenerationResult's private constructor and factories (Success/NoSource/Blocked/BlockedByPublication/Cancelled/PublicationNotCompleted set none; PassThrough/RenderFailed/SourceUnavailable each set exactly one) mean the at-most-one resolution order (pass-through -> failure -> source-failure) can never drop a present value. All emitted tokens are fixed label text plus enum member names; the subject (15.2) and result.Reason are unchanged pre-existing bounded values. No raw exception message, provider payload, path, directory, or credential enters the new code.

findings.summary: SourceUnavailable results always carry a non-null source failure reason; the only path that could emit 'SourceFailureReason=None' is unreachable in production.
findings.detail: ArtworkSourceReadResult.FailureReason is a non-nullable enum that defaults to None, so ArtworkGenerationResult.SourceUnavailable(read.FailureReason, ...) always boxes a non-null value. In GenerateCoreAsync the SourceUnavailable return is reached when read.Status == Failed (all production ArtworkSourceReader/Absent/Failed call sites pass a specific non-None reason) or when TryCreateSourceImageInput fails for a Present read (impossible: Present requires non-null ContentType and ContentSha256). Even if reached, the emitted token is a bounded enum name, not unbounded data, so this is not a redaction or security issue.
evidence: grep ArtworkSourceReadResult.Failed( in src: no None reason
findings.recommended_action: None; bounded enum, unreachable in the shipped configuration.

findings.summary: Tests pin one enum member per classification kind; fixed-member regressions for other members would not be caught.
findings.detail: The three classification theories assert exactly NoMetadata (pass-through), DecodeFailed (failure), and Unreadable (source failure). DescribeClassification interpolates the result property directly, so the label-to-field threading is proven, but no second member of any kind is driven through the log path. F8 as written requires the specific bounded classification, not exhaustive member coverage; the optional pinning suggestion is also recorded by the test-quality review (TQ-15.3-1).
